learning_objectives.en: Describe education systems using topic vocabulary.
learning_objectives.vi: Mô tả một hệ thống giáo dục bằng từ vựng đúng và ít nhất một ví dụ cụ thể.

theory.title: Nói rõ và có ví dụ

content.vi: Trả lời trực tiếp trước, sau đó giải thích cấp học hoặc lựa chọn học tập bằng một ví dụ. Tránh đọc lại nguyên văn đoạn nguồn.
content.en: Answer directly, explain one school stage or study option, and add an example in your own words.

strategies.vi: Làm bài trước khi xem đáp án; ghi lại câu chưa chắc và giải thích vì sao đáp án đúng.
strategies.en: Attempt the task first, then explain why the supported answer is right.

passages.title: S-A
passages.text: Speaking about education often requires candidates to describe systems, explain causes and effects, and make suggestions using modal verbs such as should and must. In longer answers, students should link ideas clearly and give examples.

exercises.title: Từ vựng nói về giáo dục

instruction.vi: Điền từ phù hợp rồi trả lời 2–3 câu về hệ thống giáo dục của bạn.

questions.prompt_en: Our ___ are quite strict and give us lots of homework.
questions.prompt_vi: Our ___ are quite strict and give us lots of homework.

questions.prompt_en: At university, we need to write in a more ___ style.
questions.prompt_vi: At university, we need to write in a more ___ style.

questions.prompt_en: My school includes lessons on speaking, reading and listening. The ___ also includes writing.
questions.prompt_vi: My school includes lessons on speaking, reading and listening. The ___ also includes writing.

questions.prompt_en: Our school teaches a number of ___ subjects like electronics.
questions.prompt_vi: Our school teaches a number of ___ subjects like electronics.

questions.prompt_en: Describe the education system in your country from primary school to university.
questions.prompt_vi: Describe the education system in your country from primary school to university.

answer.model_en: Primary school usually lasts five years, followed by lower and upper secondary education before university.
answer.model_vi: Primary school usually lasts five years, followed by lower and upper secondary education before university.

questions.prompt_en: Give one reason why many people think technology improves education.
questions.prompt_vi: Give one reason why many people think technology improves education.

answer.model_en: Technology gives learners quicker access to information and interactive practice.
answer.model_vi: Technology gives learners quicker access to information and interactive practice.

questions.prompt_en: State one problem in the education system in your country.
questions.prompt_vi: State one problem in the education system in your country.

answer.model_en: A common problem is that some students face too much pressure from exams.
answer.model_vi: A common problem is that some students face too much pressure from exams.
